suffix_notes.G_H_suffix_meaning: In the local TAGNT data, trailing letters such as G and H are Strong instance/sense suffixes embedded in the token strong_id. They are separate from edition_flags. Most resolve to an existing numeric base Strong ID or to another local record with the same lemma.
